params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repoPath = Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; $credText = ("protocol=https`nhost=github.com`n`n" | git -C $repoPath credential fill | Out-String); $token = (($credText -split "`n") | Where-Object { $_ -like 'password=*' } | Select-Object -First 1) -replace '^password=',''; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) { throw 'Git credential helper did not return a GitHub credential.' }; $headers = @{ Authorization = ('Bearer ' + $token); Accept='application/vnd.github+json'; 'X-GitHub-Api-Version'='2022-11-28'; 'User-Agent'='mhw-heaven-bridge' }; $job = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/fengie/mhw-mods/actions/jobs/109396498851' -Headers $headers; [ordered]@{id=$job.id;name=$job.name;status=$job.status;conclusion=$job.conclusion;runner_id=$job.runner_id;runner_name=$job.runner_name;runner_group_id=$job.runner_group_id;runner_group_name=$job.runner_group_name;labels=$job.labels;steps=$job.steps;started_at=$job.started_at;completed_at=$job.completed_at} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
